reviews.text:
Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive feedback. We are pleased that we met your expectations during your visit to the clinic.
Have a wonderful day.
We found the clinic by chance on Google, but we were very lucky because the team is fantastic. Doctors Romane and Carole are very attentive and take excellent care of our dogs.

A very bad experience. The diagnosis given for my cat was unfortunately incorrect. The clinic had identified suspected additional conditions, including anemia, but no further tests were carried out urgently despite the seriousness of the situation. I was told to go home and monitor his general condition. I'm not a specialist.

Faced with the lack of proper care and explanation, I finally consulted another veterinary clinic, which was able to identify the true illness with a proper workup: acute leukemia. Unfortunately, it was too late; there was no longer any effective treatment. My cat died two weeks later.
Beyond the misdiagnosis, I was particularly disappointed by the lack of attentiveness, the failure to acknowledge the urgency of the situation, and the fact that a complete blood count (CBC) had been performed beforehand. An extremely painful experience. I strongly advise against this unprofessional clinic.
The staff were friendly, pleasant, and punctual for appointments. I recommend them.

Dr. Romana Dufayet, the veterinarian, is very professional, gentle, and attentive.

The reception staff are also very helpful. Thank you.

Hello Mr. Bouzid,
We are delighted to see your excellent rating, thank you so much. Say hello to Mimit 🐱 …

A huge thank you to the whole team! This is my second visit, and the experience is just as positive as ever. The team is incredibly kind, very understanding, and genuinely compassionate: you can really tell they understand people's needs.

The facilities are lovely and very well-equipped. A real plus is the reception staff: the two secretaries are delightful, so cheerful and caring!

A top-notch clinic that I wholeheartedly recommend.

PS: Reading some comments about a "cold" team, I'm truly shocked. That's either pure bad faith or a major misunderstanding, because they are the complete opposite: warm, attentive, and passionate about what they do!

Selenia has now fully recovered following treatment for her cystitis.
Thank you for your prompt attention.
A very kind vet who knew how to take care of my little girl when she needed it. Thank you so much! 🥰

Hello,
I wanted to thank the entire team for Gary's recovery from diabetes. Your professionalism and deep understanding of his condition were instrumental in his healing. It's the first time I've experienced such compassionate care at a veterinary clinic!
Hello, we are delighted to know you were fully satisfied with your visit to our clinic! Thank you for this review 🐾 …
I received a very warm welcome. Everyone was very kind and patient with my cat. Thank you so much!

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. The vets' diagnoses are very accurate and all the staff are lovely.
My little dog is always pampered, spoiled, and above all, very well cared for and looked after!
Excellent practice, attentive to both animals and humans

The staff can be cold, unempathetic, and unprofessional in their dealings with clients.

I had this unfortunate experience, even though my pet has been a patient there for several years.

There are other clinics in the area besides Sévetys that are more interested in animal welfare than in the owner's wallet.
The team was attentive and very friendly. Neko felt confident from beginning to end.
Hello Ms. Abbaoui, thank you so much for these stars. We hope Cannelle is feeling better 🐱 …

I am very satisfied with my visit to the veterinary clinic on Rue Picard. We received a very warm welcome, and the veterinarian took the time to explain what she was doing, what it would reveal about my cat, answer my questions, and keep me updated by phone in the following days.
I highly recommend this team!

We recently moved to Paris and are thrilled to have found this veterinary clinic.

My two cats felt safe and comfortable there, which is rare for them.

The vet is attentive and reassuring; she took the time needed with them as well as with me.
I highly recommend them.
The staff are incredibly kind and competent. The clinic is fantastic, well-equipped, and very efficient. My cats certainly approve!

What a kind and caring team! I got an appointment very quickly, which I was able to reschedule at the last minute due to an unforeseen circumstance, with great understanding on the other end of the phone. Dr. Dufayet was extremely gentle and patient with my Kiwi, and took the time to provide information and answer all my questions. I'm so glad I found such a wonderful veterinary clinic in my neighborhood :)

This is a fantastic clinic with competent and caring vets and assistants. My two cats have been patients at this clinic for years; it's a great support for me and in the lives of my companions. A huge thank you to the entire team.
I highly recommend them. A caring vet.
Hello Mr. Burguete, a huge thank you for your feedback, thank you for your concern for the team! We are happy that Gata is doing well, please give her lots of cuddles from us 😍 …
I recommend it, it's great!
Hello Ms. Certal, thank you so much for your loyalty over all these years. It's always a pleasure to welcome you! Give Alma a cuddle 🐈 …
I've been a loyal customer of this clinic for years, the whole team is fantastic and I feel completely at ease! Don't change a thing 😃 …
Great team! They know how to build trust and reassure both animals and owners. I highly recommend them!
A serious and caring veterinary clinic
Excellent veterinarians, attentive and very professional. Thank you!

A very welcoming, professional, and attentive team. They did everything they could to treat my pet as quickly as possible. I sincerely thank them for their responsiveness and kindness. I highly recommend them!
Hello, thank you so much for your feedback 🐾 …
Hello Ms. Luthfia, thank you so much for leaving this note! We hope Yuki is doing well 😸 …

Hello, unless we are mistaken, we do not have a medical file under your name at our clinic, but rather at another clinic within the group. Please verify that your review is indeed for our clinic and, if so, contact us so we can understand your dissatisfaction and help us improve. Otherwise, we ask that you remove this unjustified review.

A very caring clinic.

You can leave your pet there with complete confidence.

I really appreciated the call a few days after the operation to check on my cat.
Hello Ms. Melan, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us this note! Give Jack a cuddle 🐈 …

A huge thank you to the entire clinic team for the care of my elderly cat, the early detection of his illness, and the flexibility they provided in his treatment (loan of products, availability, etc.). We feel very well taken care of!
The vets are very caring and attentive. Their assistants do a great job too; it's always a stressful time for my animals, but we are always very well received.
Hello, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us these 5 stars 🐾 …

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic, where I found professionalism, attentiveness, and care. My aging cat had to be hospitalized there for two nights, which wasn't easy to manage, either emotionally or financially. But I received excellent support; the explanations of the available options were very clear, and the entire team is friendly and welcoming. You can really feel that their love for animals is at the heart of their work, and yet my cat likes to be a rebel and isn't the easiest to treat... 😅
I also appreciated the follow-up after his hospitalization and the fact that they checked in on him.
I'd like to add that he's doing much better, and I hope he'll be able to enjoy a few more years of peaceful feline life!
Thank you to the whole team!
Friendly and professional staff, top-notch vet. When I go there, I know my pet will be well cared for. Well done to the team!

As a client of this clinic for several years now, I highly recommend Dr. Dufayet. She is very professional, attentive, and gentle with our animals. She takes the time to explain her prescriptions, so we leave with few doubts. She also specializes in nutrition, which is a valuable addition.

Overall, the entire team is very pleasant!
Hello Ms. Laroche, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! Give lovely Vesta a cuddle 😸 …
My favorite clinic... always takes great care of my cat

Always a great experience after several visits with my little cat.
At the first appointment, I was stressed and had lots of questions since this is my first pet on my own. I was very well received, all my questions were answered, and most importantly, I felt reassured.
My kitten isn't the gentlest with strangers, but the vet perfectly managed his behavior and also gave me advice on how to calm him down.

Pokoù and I highly recommend this clinic.

I was lucky enough to do an internship at the Pierre Picard clinic and it was a fantastic experience! The veterinarians really take the time to properly care for each animal, and the veterinary nurses are lovely, always gentle and caring. The hospitalized animals are pampered and monitored with great attention. Thank you for your warm welcome, for the time you gave me, and for all the love you put into your work! 🐾❤️

A money-grabbing clinic! Avoid at all costs!!
I won't even go into my own experience, as I was traumatized by their profound lack of empathy. They spend more time responding to Google reviews than listening to owners or properly caring for our pets.
In short: you will find competence, attentiveness, kindness, a welcoming atmosphere and trust, from Dr. Romane Dufayet and the entire team at the clinic, whom I warmly thank here.

This is my second visit to Minéa Pō Lys, and I'm extremely satisfied with both vets who examined my little girl. They were experienced, attentive, and incredibly kind to our animals. It's a very good veterinary clinic, and the prices aren't too high. It's an expense, but when our pets are sick, we're happy and relieved to know they're being cared for by such good professionals.

I highly recommend the Pierre Picard clinic in the 18th arrondissement! The entire team is exceptionally professional, always attentive and responsive to the every need of each patient (our dear little friends). You feel confident from the moment you arrive, and the care is personalized from beginning to end. A huge thank you to the whole team for their kindness and efficiency. A true benchmark in the neighborhood!
The team and Dr. Carole Debaecker were very welcoming and took excellent care of my cat Tom, who was very reassuring. I highly recommend this clinic.

Incredibly clean! I've never seen such pleasant, welcoming staff who are always smiling.

I highly recommend it.

My experience at this veterinary clinic was very unpleasant. They refused to sell me a simple ointment, even though they had it there, claiming it was because my cat wasn't taken there. The vet who treats my cat told me to bring the prescription she gave me to buy it there, but they still refused. They clearly don't care about animal health; they're only interested in lining their pockets. They lack empathy, and I hope I never need them again. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone. Veterinary clinics like this, with their cold and uncaring staff, are not needed in this world.

What a pleasure to meet such a friendly, welcoming, smiling, and competent team! I was recommended by a friend and brought Biggie in for an abscess problem! I highly recommend this vet and will gladly return.
Perfect, thank you!
A fantastic team, from the reception staff to the veterinarians...very attentive and they adore our animal friends...and always very gentle with our cat Billy...Well done!

Top-notch clinic!

From the vets to the assistants, the entire team is dedicated, attentive to their furry patients, and always has the right words to reassure their owners.

I highly recommend them.
A thousand thanks from me and Josephine.
Professional and friendly staff

I haven't been a customer for years. They arrived and everything changed.

First of all, they have ridiculously low prices. For the same consultation, one charges €150 and the other €75. They rip off their customers and have no respect for animals.

When you try to pick up your pet after a difficult operation, she's too busy laughing with her friend and just drops your pet off at the door after you've paid €297, or she ignores you at reception because she can't figure out how to set up her insurance.
Avoid at all costs.

A very warm welcome, always attentive and caring. Professional, kind, and caring staff.
I highly recommend them.
Very warm welcome and good advice. During the annual check-up, Thy accepted the brushing, nail trimming, his two vaccinations, and weighing very well.
I was incredibly surprised by the professionalism, kindness and human/animal approach. I highly recommend it; I'm almost hoping my cat has something so I can go back.

Hello Mr. Rondello,
We would like to sincerely thank you for this excellent rating. Hugs to Pepino 🫶
Attentive, alert, and caring team, concerned about the animal.
Excellent veterinary clinic. Everyone is reassuring, professional, and attentive.
Local veterinary practice that sends appointment reminders and remains attentive to all your expectations.
They are super nice and great with animals
Delighted, they take their time, they listen, I recommend them

I can say without a doubt that my dog's untimely death could have been avoided if the veterinarians at this clinic were more competent. They refused to order any imaging or other tests because, according to the vet, "osteoarthritis is visible to the naked eye, and this was clearly arthritis." My dog ​​died a few weeks later. It wasn't arthritis, but a tumor on her liver that eventually bled. She suffered for weeks because of you. And we obviously spent hundreds of euros on acupuncture, injections, simple consultations, and so on.
Unfortunately, it makes you wonder if they do this out of love for animals.
Pleasant and professional in my opinion, but €180 for a single appointment for my cat with a urine analysis... that's very expensive!!!

Very professional, young, and dynamic team! Modern and clean clinic.

Bonus: leopard print bandage 👌🏻😻.
Thank you!!! …
Fantastic vet! Attentive, friendly, and thorough. My cat felt very comfortable in their skilled hands, and I was very reassured. :) I highly recommend them. Thank you!

Hello Ms. Alves, we appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. Please feel free to explain why you gave us 4 stars instead of 5; this will be very helpful in our ongoing improvement process. Give Isis a cuddle 🐾 …
Excellent clinic. The vet was attentive and proactive. Delighted!
Hello, a huge thank you from the whole team for these 5 stars!
Thank you to the whole team for the warm welcome and care given to my little darling. I'm so glad to have you as my vet so close to home; it's very reassuring. I highly recommend you!
Hello Ms. Boussif, thank you for your feedback, it means a lot to us! We hope Ernesto and Chilly are doing well 🐈 …
Hello Ms. Azzaro, thank you so much for this feedback!
The place was very clean, and the staff were super friendly. No unnecessary waiting. I was pleasantly surprised.
Hello Mr. Landaeta, thank you so much for the 5 stars! See you soon and say hello to Mookie!!
He's the vet for my two cats. The animals are well cared for by professionals with a lot of heart.

Dr Romane Dufayet is amazing! We get help with traveling out side Paris. After the appointment I needed more help to continue traveling and Dr Dufayet help me by email and answering my questions. She is professional, super nice, love animals and caring! The clinic very clean and pleasant
I highly recommend it!
Excellent clinic. The staff are kind and welcoming and always find a way to get you an appointment quickly. I highly recommend it!

Just one visit so far, but the vet agreed to see me and my dog ​​at the last minute, even though he wasn't a patient at this clinic.
We came after he was attacked by another dog in a park, but the vet took the time to examine him, and we took the opportunity to discuss two other issues that our previous vet hadn't even bothered to look into, despite several visits and requests from us.
They were wonderful with my dog. The x-rays, which weren't exactly pleasant for him, were done gently, taking all the time necessary, and I think the follow-up care will be just as thorough as this first visit.
Thanks again from Haku, "the super friendly Shiba," and his owner!
We received a wonderful welcome from a fantastic team for our little Moham. Thank you so much. Aider Défendre Aimer Association.
Thank you so much, all the staff are very kind, I'm very happy!
